title: strcpy into 16-byte stack buffer without length check in parse_tenant_tag()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/packet_parse.c:L20 calls strcpy(tag, header) where tag is a 16-byte stack buffer and header is a function parameter with no length validation; a header string longer than 15 characters overflows adjacent stack memory. The scanner rule fired as CWE-676 but the actual defect is CWE-121 (stack-based buffer overflow).

title: Off-by-one in copy_labels() writes one byte past end of key->labels[MAX_LABELS]
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/packet_parse.c:L39 loops with i <= count instead of i < count; with key->labels declared as unsigned char labels[MAX_LABELS] (MAX_LABELS=8 per packet.h), a caller passing count=8 causes key->labels[8] to be written, overflowing the struct field by one byte and potentially corrupting adjacent struct members.
